$comment: The behaviour suite's CI time budget (#71, FR-013, NFR-001).
The charter's Performance Benchmarks say 'Storybook CI build time under 3 minutes' and
contemplate no test suite at all — ADR-11's own Consequences say 'a new budget has to be
set rather than assumed'. This is that budget, ASSERTED rather than recorded: the job
fails above the ceiling, so the number cannot go stale silently.
WHERE THIS LIVES IS AN OPEN OPERATOR QUESTION. Amending the charter's Performance
Benchmarks may be the right home, but charter.md and charter.yaml currently contradict
each other and the citation for how amendments happen does not check out — see the
operator questions on #71. Until that is settled the budget lives here and in ADR-11's
Consequences, both of which this mission may edit.
The ceiling covers the SUITE ONLY. scripts/suite-selftest.mjs runs fifteen more suites
and is 5-10x this figure; it is a separate CI step and is deliberately not inside this
measurement, because a ceiling that mixes them cannot tell you which one regressed.
covers: npm run test (both lanes, chromium + webkit in CI)
measuredOn: ubuntu-latest, chromium + webkit, cold npm ci
